rationale: S-0026-02 proposes an AR(2) rho x V_rest sweep on the t0024 (de Rosenroll port) DSGC. The t0024 testbed has been de-emphasised since brainstorm 9 in favour of the from-scratch substrate. The AR(2) noise question remains scientifically valid but is no longer on the critical path; should be re-considered after the from-scratch wave gives a stable baseline DSI to compare noise sensitivity against. Reprioritising from high to medium.
